settings.followsVsCode: Theme and language follow your VS Code settings.
settings.syncDescription: Use my Git Rudder account settings. This VS Code uses your accounts, your Git and AI preferences and, if you turned it on in your account, your AI keys. Theme, language and the rest of the editor are synced by VS Code.
settings.cfgCloud: Use my Git Rudder account settings
settings.cfgCloudD: This VS Code uses your account's linked accounts, AI keys and Git and AI preferences. What's stored in the cloud is chosen in your account. VS Code syncs the theme, language and the rest of the editor.
settings.cfgLogLevel: How much the Git Rudder engine writes to the "Git Rudder Engine" output channel. This machine only.
settings.cfgHeader: Git Rudder Desktop shares these preferences and they're stored in your Git Rudder account. They don't appear in VS Code's settings.
settings.aiHint: For commit messages we recommend a fast, low-cost model. For PRs and summaries, a balanced one. Your key pays for every generation.
settings.excludeD: On top of .env, *.pem, *.key and others Git Rudder always excludes.

host.noFolder: Open a folder with a Git repository to see its graph.
host.engineStopped: The Git Rudder engine stopped after crashing several times.
host.protocolMismatch: This Git Rudder installation is damaged: the engine uses protocol version {engine} and the extension expects {expected}. Reinstall the extension.

auth.cardSignedOut: Sign in to use your Git Rudder account's accounts, keys and preferences in this VS Code. Git works the same without an account.
auth.progressBrowser: Signing in to Git Rudder: finish in your browser.
auth.slowBrowser: Browser didn't open or didn't come back to VS Code?
auth.codeDetail: {code}. It expires in 10 minutes. Only approve it if you requested it on this device.
auth.waitingApproval: Waiting for approval in the browser…
auth.reasonDenied: you cancelled the authorization in the browser.
auth.reasonNetwork: Git Rudder can't be reached. Local Git keeps working.
auth.signOutDetail: Your vault key and the accounts and keys that came from other devices are removed from this device. The ones you added here stay so Git keeps working.
auth.signOutWipe: Sign Out and Also Remove the Ones Added Here
auth.otherWindowOut: Git Rudder was signed out in another window.

status.syncTip: {behind} commits to pull and {ahead} to push
status.signedOutTip: Signed out. Local Git works the same. Sign in to sync accounts, keys and preferences.
status.cloudOffTip: Git Rudder cloud is turned off in this VS Code.
status.publishTip: The branch {branch} isn't on any remote yet.

welcome.noFolder: Open a folder with a Git repository, or clone one, to see its graph. No account needed.
welcome.notRepo: The open folder isn't a Git repository.
welcome.notRepoMulti: None of the open folders is a Git repository.
welcome.pickFolder: Choose the folder to initialize the repository in
welcome.gitMissing: Git Rudder needs Git 2.34 or later and can't find it on this machine. If it's somewhere else, set it in the `git.path` setting.
welcome.gitOld: Git Rudder needs Git 2.34 or later. The version it found is older.
welcome.gitRemote: Git Rudder runs on the remote machine and needs Git 2.34 or later installed there.

engine.bannerReconnect: Reconnecting to the Git Rudder engine…
engine.engineStopped: The Git Rudder engine stopped 5 times in 3 minutes and won't restart on its own.
engine.protocolBroken: The extension is damaged: the engine and the interface aren't the same version. Reinstall Git Rudder.
engine.noBinary: This Git Rudder install doesn't include the engine for {os} {arch}. Install the extension from the Marketplace or Open VSX so VS Code picks the right build.

repo.pickRepo: Choose the repository Git Rudder's views show
repo.repoGone: {repo} is no longer a repository. Its graph was closed.

graph.staleWindow: The history changed. The graph was reloaded from the top.
graph.emptyRepo: This repository has no commits yet. Stage files and make the first commit on {branch}.
graph.detached: Detached HEAD at {sha}. Commits you make here don't belong to any branch.

push.pushRejected: Push rejected: origin/{branch} has commits you don't have.
push.noUpstream: The branch {branch} isn't on any remote yet.

dirty.dirtyCheckout_other: Can't check out {branch}: your changes to {count} files would be overwritten.
dirty.dirtyCheckout_one: Can't check out {branch}: your changes to {count} file would be overwritten.

history.followsRenames: Includes commits from before it was renamed
history.noHistory: This file isn't in the history yet.

tag.tagMsg: Message (optional; empty creates a lightweight tag)

account.prNoAccount: To see and create pull requests for this repository, connect an account on its platform.
account.prNoAccountMsg: The remote is on {host}. No account is connected for that host.
account.prUnknownHost: Git Rudder doesn't recognize this remote's platform. If it's GitLab, Gitea, Forgejo or GitHub Enterprise, add an account for that host.
account.prNoRemote: This repository has no remote. Pull requests need one.
account.pickPlatform: Which platform is the account on?
account.azureOrg: Azure DevOps organization. The token must be scoped to that organization.
account.tokenPrompt: Paste the token. Git Rudder stores it in VS Code's secret storage and never shows it again.

errors.platRate: {platform} rate limit reached. We'll try again at {time}.
errors.platSso: The {org} organization requires SSO authorization for the token.
errors.aiQuota: Your {provider} account is out of credit or hit its quota.
errors.aiModelGone: The model {model} is no longer available.
errors.orgProxyTitle: This key belongs to your organization
errors.orgProxyDetail: To generate the message, your staged changes go through Git Rudder's servers, which use {org}'s key. With a personal key they don't.
errors.aiOrgLimit_other: You reached your daily AI limit in {org} ({count} requests). It resets tomorrow.
errors.aiOrgLimit_one: You reached your daily AI limit in {org} ({count} request). It resets tomorrow.

desktop.noDesktop: Git Rudder Desktop doesn't seem to be installed on this machine.

manifest.untrustedDesc: Git Rudder runs Git in the folder, and Git can run hooks and configuration from the repository itself. Trust the folder to use Git Rudder.
manifest.virtualDesc: Git Rudder needs Git and local files. It doesn't work on vscode.dev or github.dev.

deleteBranch.detail: It has commits that aren't on any other branch.

deleteRemoteBranch.detail: It is deleted for the whole team.

deleteTag.detail: If it's already on origin, you can delete it there too.

disconnectAccount.detail: Git Rudder stops using it on this and your other devices. It doesn't revoke the token on {platform}.

deleteAiKey.detail: Features that used it switch to the default key.

abortOperation.detail: Resolved conflicts are discarded and the branch goes back to how it was before you started.
